title: cerastium macrocarpum subsp. lucorum
intro: Cerastium macrocarpum subsp. lucorum, commonly known as Mountain Avens, is a flowering plant species belonging to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate various health issues such as wounds, infections, and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Avens include wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Additionally, the bioactive compounds present in Mountain Avens, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, may contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, providing potential therapeutic benefits.
